A GROUNDBREAKING PERFORMER
Caliber takes its fuel effi ciency seriously, with up to 29 miles per gallon.* Fuel economy goes hand in hand with engines and drivetrains rigorously tested for maximum performance and durability.
1 WORLD ENGINE.
Four World Engines are offered — 1.8-liter, 2.0-liter, 2.4-liter, and 2.4-liter Turbo — which provide 148, 158, 172, and 285 horsepower, respectively. They meet aggressive
performance and fuel economy targets through advanced cylinder head port and intake manifold design. State-of-the-art automotive technologies include dual Variable Valve Timing (VVT) and an
2 CVT2.
intake with fl ow control valves. Combined, these features produce more power, better fuel economy and smoother, quieter operation than engines without them. The CVT2 is a second-
generation Continuously Variable Transaxle (CVT2) calibrated for precise ratio control. A Continuously Variable Transaxle operates by varying the working diameters of the two main pulleys in the
transaxle. The CVT2 allows the engine to run at optimum rpm to provide approximately 8 percent better fuel economy.† The CVT2 also allows the fuel injection to remain off during deceleration, as the
transaxle works its way down to the lowest ratio, ingeniously saving more gas.
*2008 preliminary EPA estimated 24 city/29 highway mpg with 1.8L engine with 5-speed manual transaxle. †Combined EPA city/highway fuel economy of Caliber’s 2.0L engine with CVT2 (25 mpg) compared to Dodge’s comparable 4-speed automatic transaxle.

285 horsepower and 265 lb-ft of torque. For handling that kind of power smoothly, SRT4 also features a 6-speed Getrag manual transmission and SRT-enhanced braking system. Inside,

performance pedigrees at the SRT Track Experience, a complimentary one-day driving school conducted by the pros. Prepare to qualify at dodge.com/caliber, drivesrt.com
or call 800-4ADODGE.

SAFETY AND SECURITY
1 CRUSH ZONES.
High-strength, hot-stamped steel provides Caliber’s body and chassis with high levels of impact protection. The combination of
strengthened materials and engineered crush zones — sections of the core structure designed to divert and dissipate energy away from the passengers —
2 ALL-WHEEL DRIVE (AWD).
help ensure that Caliber is tough to the core. Caliber R/T AWD hits the scene with an electronically controlled
all-wheel-drive system with variable torque output and an available Electronic Stability Program (ESP).* Without driver input, Caliber’s system
seamlessly transfers power to assist any wheel in need. In doing so, the AWD system benefi ts both straight-line traction and cornering stability.
3 ADVANCED MULTISTAGE AIR BAGS.
† As standard equipment, Caliber features multistage driver and front-passenger air bags. Side-curtain
air bags are also standard across all trim levels, extending protection to both rows of Caliber’s outboard passengers. Front seat-mounted side air bags
are optional. All Caliber models also include a driver’s infl atable knee blocker as standard equipment. 4 ANTILOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS). 3
State-of-the-art electronics allow Caliber’s available antilock brake system to provide faster response times than previous systems. ABS is standard on
Caliber R/T and Caliber models equipped with the CVT2 (available on all models). ABS helps prevent wheel-lock and maintains directional control when
braking on slippery surfaces.
*No system, no matter how sophisticated, can repeal the laws of physics or overcome careless driving actions. Performance is limited by available traction, which snow, ice and other conditions
can affect. When the ESP warning lamp in the speedometer fl ashes, the driver needs to use less throttle and adapt speed and driving behavior to prevailing road conditions. Always drive carefully,
consistent with conditions. Always wear your seat belt. †Always sit properly in the seat with the seat belt fastened. Children 12 and under should always be in a backseat correctly using an infant
or child restraint system or the seat belt positioned correctly for the child’s age and weight.

In addition to the standard equipment of the SE trim level, Caliber SXT includes a chrome grille, 17-inch painted aluminum wheels, air conditioning with Chill Zone® beverage storage
bin, power automatic door locks, power exterior mirrors, power windows, remote keyless entry, tachometer, reclining rear seat, cargo light with removable, rechargeable LED fl ashlight,

In addition to the standard equipment of the SXT trim level, Caliber R/T offers the 2.4-liter dual VVT with CVT2 and AutoStick, available all-wheel drive (AWD), performance-tuned

optional leather-trimmed seating, color-keyed, instrument panel trim accents, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, and more.

SRT-tuned ABS system, all-speed traction control with brake lock differential, and a lowered, SRT-tuned suspension along with 19” aluminum wheels give the SRT4 standout looks and performance.

--- page 14 ---
1
Caliber R/T in Bright Silver Metallic.
For more on Caliber’s safety surrounds, visit dodge.com/caliber/safety_security. 2
SAFETY AND SECURITY
1 CRUSH ZONES.
High-strength, hot-stamped steel provides Caliber’s body and chassis with high levels of impact protection. The combination of
strengthened materials and engineered crush zones — sections of the core structure designed to divert and dissipate energy away from the passengers —
2 ALL-WHEEL DRIVE (AWD).
help ensure that Caliber is tough to the core. Caliber R/T AWD hits the scene with an electronically controlled
all-wheel-drive system with variable torque output and an available Electronic Stability Program (ESP).* Without driver input, Caliber’s system
seamlessly transfers power to assist any wheel in need. In doing so, the AWD system benefi ts both straight-line traction and cornering stability.
3 ADVANCED MULTISTAGE AIR BAGS.
† As standard equipment, Caliber features multistage driver and front-passenger air bags. Side-curtain
air bags are also standard across all trim levels, extending protection to both rows of Caliber’s outboard passengers. Front seat-mounted side air bags
are optional. All Caliber models also include a driver’s infl atable knee blocker as standard equipment. 4 ANTILOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS). 3
State-of-the-art electronics allow Caliber’s available antilock brake system to provide faster response times than previous systems. ABS is standard on
Caliber R/T and Caliber models equipped with the CVT2 (available on all models). ABS helps prevent wheel-lock and maintains directional control when
